types.name: tradews.v1.AckResponse
types.doc: AckResponse carries the command-specific public Orders API acknowledgement.

fields.name: create_order
fields.doc: Accepted create-order response.

fields.name: cancel_order
fields.doc: Accepted cancel-order response.

fields.name: modify_order
fields.doc: Accepted modify-order response.

fields.name: cancel_all_orders
fields.doc: Accepted cancel-all response.

types.name: tradews.v1.ClientFrame
types.doc:
ClientFrame is the protobuf write-websocket envelope. The payloads reuse the
 public Orders API DTOs so protobuf clients do not learn a second order model.

fields.name: seq
fields.doc: Monotonic per-connection client sequence number, starting at 1.

fields.name: correlation_id
fields.doc: Client correlation token echoed in every server response.

fields.name: ping
fields.doc: Liveness request that does not submit an order command.

fields.name: create_order
fields.doc: Create-order command using the public Orders API DTO.

fields.name: cancel_order
fields.doc: Cancel-order command using the public Orders API DTO.

fields.name: modify_order
fields.doc: Modify-order command using the public Orders API DTO.

fields.name: cancel_all_orders
fields.doc: Cancel-all command using the public Orders API DTO.

types.name: tradews.v1.CommandReject
types.doc: CommandReject reports a command-level failure without closing the session.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable machine-readable reject code.

fields.name: detail
fields.doc: Client-safe diagnostic detail.

types.name: tradews.v1.OverloadResponse
types.doc: OverloadResponse reports that the session exceeded server admission limits.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable machine-readable overload code.

fields.name: detail
fields.doc: Client-safe diagnostic detail.

types.name: tradews.v1.PingRequest
types.doc: PingRequest carries an opaque payload that is echoed by PongResponse.

fields.name: payload
fields.doc: Opaque client payload echoed by the server.

fields.name: payload
fields.doc: Opaque payload copied from PingRequest.

types.name: tradews.v1.ServerFrame
types.doc: ServerFrame is the protobuf write-websocket response envelope.

fields.name: seq
fields.doc: Client sequence number copied from the accepted or rejected frame.

fields.name: correlation_id
fields.doc: Client correlation token copied from the accepted or rejected frame.

fields.name: pong
fields.doc: Liveness response for PingRequest.

fields.name: ack
fields.doc: Successful command acknowledgement.

fields.name: reject
fields.doc: Command-level reject with a stable machine-readable code.

fields.name: overload
fields.doc: Server overload response when the session cannot admit more work.

fields.name: terminal
fields.doc: Terminal session-level response after which the server closes the stream.

types.name: tradews.v1.TerminalSessionEvent
types.doc: TerminalSessionEvent reports a terminal session condition.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable machine-readable terminal code.

fields.name: detail
fields.doc: Client-safe diagnostic detail.
